name: seedeep
description: Live context & subagent visualizer for Claude Code

scripts.build:client: bun build apps/server/src/client/app.ts --outdir apps/server/public/lib --target browser --format esm
scripts.check:rust: command -v cargo >/dev/null || { echo 'seedeep: cargo is not on PATH, so the tray cannot be built. Run  source $HOME/.cargo/env  in this shell, or add that line to your shell profile — rustup does not always add it. If Rust is not installed at all: https://rustup.rs' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.tray:dev: bun run check:rust && export SEEDEEP_HOME=$PWD/.seedeep-dev && cd apps/tray && bunx tauri dev
scripts.tray:build: bun run check:rust && cd apps/tray && bunx tauri build
scripts.test:tray: bun run check:rust && cd apps/tray/src-tauri && cargo test
